title: SQS from C#
description: Use Amazon SQS for message queuing with the AWSSDK.SQS package.

data.text: Amazon SQS is a fully managed message queue service. It decouples components so they can scale independently, retry failed work, and survive downstream outages.

data.title: Send a message to an SQS queue
Receive a message and delete it after processing
data.content: Use ReceiveMessageAsync with a CancellationToken and handle errors gracefully.

data.title: Visibility Timeout
data.text: After receiving a message, it becomes invisible to other consumers for the visibility timeout. If your processing takes longer, extend it or the message may be received again.

data.title: Build an order queue processor
data.description: Create a background service that polls an SQS queue and processes orders.
steps: Create an IHostedService that polls SQS
Deserialize the message body into an Order object
Save the order to your database
Delete the message only after successful save
data.expectedOutcome: Orders are processed reliably from the queue and duplicates are minimized.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SQS provides at-least-once delivery between decoupled services
Always delete messages after successful processing
Use long polling to reduce empty responses
data.takeaway: SQS is the backbone of resilient, decoupled ASP.NET Core applications on AWS.
